Manufacturing performance in apparel and home textile factories is created on the factory floor. VCG combines consulting, technical expertise and implementation to help manufacturers diagnose problems, design practical solutions, build organisational capability and sustain measurable improvements.

The problems we solve

Factories come to VCG when the numbers stop adding up.

Productivity below potential

Machines, manpower and systems exist — but output stays below what the line is actually capable of.→ Industrial Engineering, Line Balancing

Quality instability

Defects, DHU, rework and customer claims persist despite inspection and controls being in place.→ Quality Systems

Capacity constraints

Demand exists, but bottlenecks in layout, flow or planning prevent full capacity utilisation.→ Factory Setup, Re-engineering

Rising manufacturing cost

Labour, overheads, wastage and process inefficiency continue to erode margin.→ Cost Optimisation

Weak management systems

Data exists on the floor, but management lacks the visibility and structure to act on it daily.→ Digital MIS, Performance Management

New factory / expansion

An investment decision needs to become an operationally viable, running factory.→ Factory Setup & Expansion

How we implement

Five stages. One team, from diagnosis to sustained result.

01 / DG

Diagnose

Factory assessment, data analysis and shop-floor observation to establish an honest baseline — not an assumed one.

02 / DS

Design

Practical operating systems, layouts, processes and KPIs designed around your product, people and constraints.

03 / IM

Implement

Hands-on execution alongside the factory team — on the floor, not only in the report.

04 / BC

Build Capability

Training, documented systems and clear accountability, so the improvement doesn't depend on VCG staying on-site.

05 / SU

Sustain

Management routines, KPIs and governance mechanisms that keep the improvement in place after handover.

Factory Transformation

From a new factory's first feasibility study to a fundamental redesign of how an existing one operates.

New Factory Setup & Expansion

Turning an investment decision into an operationally viable, running factory — or scaling an existing one. VCG plans capacity, layout and manpower before the first machine is installed, then stays through commissioning and early-stage stabilisation.

Feasibility & ROIProject planningFactory layout & infrastructureMachinery & equipment planningProject executionOperational readinessRecruitment & initial skill setupCommissioningPost-commissioning supportFactory expansion

Factory Assessment & Gap Analysis

Before recommending anything, VCG establishes what's actually happening on the floor — through functional audits, benchmarking and root-cause analysis — and maps the gap between current and target performance.

Functional auditsCurrent-system evaluationPerformance benchmarkingBottleneck identificationAs-Is → To-Be mappingRoot-cause analysisImprovement roadmap

Re-engineering & Transformation

Redesign the way the factory works.

For factories where the problem isn't a single process but the operating model itself. VCG redesigns workflows, restructures departments and realigns people, process and technology — then implements the redesigned system, rather than only documenting it. Day-to-day productivity work — line balancing, Kaizen, 5S, KPI monitoring — sits under Operational Excellence unless it's part of a broader redesign like this.

Approach

Diagnose. Design. Implement. Build Capability. Sustain.

This is what actually happens at each stage — not a slide, a sequence VCG runs on every engagement, in this order, because skipping a stage is the most common reason improvement doesn't last.

01 — DIAGNOSE

Diagnose — Establish the Factory Baseline

Before any recommendation, VCG establishes an honest baseline of the factory as it actually runs — not as it's assumed to run.

  • Functional audits across production, quality, IE, HR and stores
  • Shop-floor observation and time studies
  • Current-system evaluation and performance benchmarking
  • Root-cause analysis of productivity and quality gaps
02 — DESIGN

Design — Build the Operating System

Solutions are built around your product, process and people — not dropped in from a generic playbook.

  • "As-is" vs. "to-be" process mapping
  • Layout, line and system design
  • KPI framework and target-setting
  • Action plan and implementation roadmap
03 — IMPLEMENT

Implement — Execute on the Factory Floor

VCG stays on the floor through execution — this is the stage that separates VCG from firms that submit a report and leave.

  • Hands-on execution with supervisors and line teams
  • Pilot lines before factory-wide rollout
  • Live troubleshooting as systems go live
  • Direct coordination with management on progress
04 — BUILD CAPABILITY

Build Capability — Transfer Ownership to the Factory Team

An improvement that depends on VCG staying on-site permanently isn't a sustainable one. This stage transfers ownership.

  • Operator, supervisor and manager training
  • Documented SOPs built for daily use, not a shelf
  • Clarified roles and accountability
  • Skill-matrix development and gap closure
05 — SUSTAIN

Sustain

The final stage is governance — the routines that keep the improvement in place once VCG steps back.

  • Management review cadence and KPI dashboards
  • Internal audit and review mechanisms
  • Incentive structures linked to sustained performance
  • Periodic follow-up reviews post-engagement

Business Challenge

  • Client planning to move into a new building and required a professionally designed, optimised layout
  • No internal expertise in factory layout planning or industrial engineering to design the new facility
  • Required a layout that would eliminate the inefficiencies of the existing factories and support future capacity growth

Scope of Work

Factory Layout DesignIndustrial EngineeringCapacity PlanningMaterial Flow OptimisationOperations

  • Optimised factory layout design for the new building with department zoning and flow planning
  • Material flow diagrams and workstation placement recommendations
  • Capacity utilisation projections and space allocation plan for the new facility

Business Outcomes

30% capacity increaseOptimised material flow in new factoryProfessional layout design deliveredFuture capacity growth enabled

About VCG

We have been on the factory floor.

Vinkesh Consulting Group (VCG) is a specialist consulting and implementation firm for apparel, home textile, leather and technical textile manufacturing. VCG is led by practitioners with direct, hands-on experience in production, industrial engineering, quality and factory management — roles held, not only advised on.

We partner with factory owners and leadership teams to design, implement and stabilise systems at the shop-floor level. Our expertise spans the full value chain — from factory setup and process re-engineering to quality management systems, SOP development and digital MIS.

Our consulting is not limited to reports and presentations. We work directly on the ground, guiding implementation and staying involved through stabilisation — because a recommendation is only worth as much as the factory's ability to run it after we leave.
